messages:
Ava (Product): Heads-up 10am sync: we need to decide sprint focus. Customer X wants a private pilot (HSM + dedicated capacity + SLA) starting in ~6 weeks. Alternatively, we can push the full Optimize initiative (adaptive batching + model quant recommendations) this cycle. We can't do both. Thoughts?
Marcus (Eng): Do we have hard launch gates for the pilot? Need clear, measurable criteria.
Ava (Product): Proposed launch criteria:
- Pilot served from Dedicated pool
- p95 latency <= 200ms under 1k rps synthetic load
- Security sign-off for HSM/KMS + audit logs
- Model version pinned and rollback path validated
Lina (Runtime Eng): To hit p95=200ms we need adaptive batching behind a toggle, plus prefix KV warmup for the tenant. Canary requires 48h on a dedicated canary GPU. Quantization profile must be smoke-validated against our eval set before we flip it.
Ravi (Infra PM): Note on capacity: reserved pool in region has ~3 week lead time after approval. Autoscale webhooks and billing quota wiring need an API; we can stub for canary but prod needs the real hook.
Sofia (Security): HSM checklist: key provisioning, rotation, attestation logs, audit event stream. We need an acceptance test demonstrating rotation without decrypt failures. ETA: ~2w after infra preflight. Also need SLA dataflow diagram for compliance review.
oncall-bot: reminder: provisioning template https://intra/redwood/provisioning-template
Marcus (Eng): Summarizing blockers: infra lead time (~3w), security preflight (~2w post-infra), runtime validation (quant + batching). Target 6w pilot is feasible only if we cut scope.
Ava (Product): My recommendation: prioritize Customer X pilot, defer noncritical Optimize features (full dashboard/visualizer). Keep the core runtime changes that matter for latency (adaptive batching toggle + KV warmup) so runtime effort reduced ~30%.
Lina (Runtime Eng): With those cuts we can focus on:
- Adaptive batching behind feature flag
- Tenant KV warmup script
- Quick quant smoke harness against eval prompts
Canary plan ready once infra provides GPUs.
Ravi (Infra PM): I'll submit the dedicated pool request today with urgent priority. If approved, provisioning still ~3w. I can expose an autoscale stub for canary within 1 week. Tracking ticket INF-4621.
Sofia (Security): I'll draft the HSM acceptance checklist and schedule preflight review. Ava, attach the dataflow diagram please so we don't block.
Ava (Product): Uploaded diagram: https://intra/redwood/diagrams/customerX-dataflow.svg
Marcus (Eng): Action owners (I will own runtime changes):
- Marcus (Eng): runtime PR (toggle + smoke tests)
- Lina (Runtime Eng): KV warmup + quant harness
- Ravi (Infra PM): dedicated pool + autoscale stub (INF-4621)
- Sofia (Security): HSM acceptance + audit events
- Ava (Product): customer comms + acceptance criteria
Canary window: 48h; Launch gates: p95<=200ms, security sign-off, rollback tested.
Ava (Product): Decision: prioritize Customer X pilot, defer noncritical Optimize work. Marcus: can you open the initial PR by Tue EOD?
Marcus (Eng): Yes, will have PR up Tue EOD with feature flag and smoke tests.
Lina (Runtime Eng): KV warmup script and quant smoke harness targeted for Wed.
Ravi (Infra PM): Pool request submitted; INF-4621 created. Ill post updates there.
Sofia (Security): HSM preflight scheduled; checklist posted to INF-4621.
Ava (Product): I'll notify Customer X of prioritization and share acceptance criteria and tentative windows. Thanks team :thumbsup:
